end.summary:
Ayaan practised choosing exact or approximate values for runs, crowds, bank money, and school fees.
Ayaan practised rounding large numbers to the nearest lakh and crore; some answers were right, but the method was not steady yet and needs checking next time.
Ayaan practised judging rounding error and identifying which rounded value is closer; this also needs further checking next time.
Ayaan calculated that rounding 1,196 to 1,000 gives an error of 196 and selected ₹300 when rounding ₹251 to the nearest hundred.
end.parentNote: Asha practised exact versus approximate values, rounding to lakhs and crores, and finding the error caused by rounding. Ayaan used place-value digits in several answers and calculated the ₹1,196 example’s rounding difference as ₹196. Rounding rules and error estimates were not yet steady, so at home, use a few prices or population figures and ask Ayaan to name the rounding place, rounded value, and difference from the original.
